classification: custom-aligned B2D research reward; report-aligned but not an official Bench2Drive aggregate and not a disclosed ReCogDrive reward
activation_status: inactive until candidate rollout cache and held-out correlation gates pass

design_principle.navsim_analogy: PDMS multiplies safety/feasibility penalties by a weighted average of progress, TTC and comfort
design_principle.bench2drive_translation: store the official B2D sufficient statistics and use their non-redundant decomposition as the Pareto vector
design_principle.forbidden_shortcut: do not call a NAVSIM scorer on B2D trajectories and do not label B2D-RAS as PDMS

official_route_state.route_completion: RC in [0,1], converted directly from official score_route percentage
official_route_state.infraction_penalty: P in [0,1], exact product of official B2D V0.0.3 event factors
official_route_state.strict_infraction_free: all official infractions except minimum-speed are absent; route deviation, blocking and route timeout also fail this flag
official_route_state.efficiency_accumulator: sum and count of valid official speed percentages at the 20 route checkpoints; individual values >1000% are filtered
official_route_state.smoothness_accumulator: number of official two-second smooth segments passed and total valid segments
official_route_state.ability_metadata: official ability labels plus the special Traffic-Signs junction outcome

exact_report_reconstruction.route_success: route_finished and target_reached and RC == 1 and strict_infraction_free
exact_report_reconstruction.driving_efficiency: mean of each valid route's checkpoint speed-percentage mean; routes without a first check are omitted exactly as in the official tool
exact_report_reconstruction.driving_smoothness: 100 * mean(route smooth-segment pass ratio) over valid routes
exact_report_reconstruction.multi_ability: route success grouped by Merging, Overtaking, Emergency Brake, Give Way and Traffic Signs; preserve the official additional Traffic-Signs junction contribution

pareto_objectives.infraction_compliance: P, the exact official multiplicative infraction penalty
pareto_objectives.route_completion: RC, the exact official DS progress component

driving_efficiency.reason: positive affine normalization preserves arithmetic means and model ordering over the same valid-route set; clipping or logarithms do not, while missing routes are handled by the explicit coverage guard

constraint_dominance.primary_constraint: sr_feasible = strict_infraction_free and (route is non-terminal or terminal_success), using the exact SR infraction rule with minimum-speed excluded
constraint_dominance.rule: an SR-feasible candidate dominates an infeasible candidate; when feasibility matches, apply ordinary Pareto dominance to the four-objective vector

pareto_objectives.why_sr_is_not_a_fifth_objective: SR is the terminal indicator derived from RC and strict infraction-free; it is enforced through constraint dominance instead of duplicated as a sparse objective
pareto_objectives.why_ability_is_not_a_per_candidate_dimen: Multi-Ability is the same route-success signal grouped by scenario; use ability-balanced sampling and report the five group aggregates

report_aligned_scalar_baseline.name: B2D-RAS
report_aligned_scalar_baseline.formula: B2D-RAS = U if sr_feasible else -1 + 0.25 * U
report_aligned_scalar_baseline.feasibility_property: every SR-feasible state scores in [0,1], every infeasible state scores in [-1,-0.75], and all-infeasible groups retain residual ordering
report_aligned_scalar_baseline.reason: the strict barrier directly represents SR feasibility; within each feasibility class, DS components remain primary while Efficiency and Smoothness are separately reported secondary outcomes
report_aligned_scalar_baseline.use: plain-GRPO chain validation and scalar ablation only; Pareto training consumes the canonical four-objective vector

candidate_transition.input: before route state plus a candidate-specific projected after route state
candidate_transition.grpo_group_reward: apply SR constraint dominance, then compare after-state objective potentials because every candidate in a group shares the same before state
candidate_transition.sequential_reward: use after-potential minus before-potential; the DS and B2D-RAS potential differences telescope across a route
required_invariants: efficiency and smoothness accumulator counts cannot decrease
ability labels cannot change within a route

candidate_rollout_requirements.controller: same PID and control frequency used by the closed-loop B2D agent
candidate_rollout_requirements.environment_preference: reactive CARLA rollout is the reference; non-reactive log replay is a cheaper proxy that must be calibrated
candidate_rollout_requirements.other_agents_for_proxy: interpolate future B2D actor boxes to rollout ticks
candidate_rollout_requirements.official_event_logic: reuse B2D event semantics for collisions, red lights, stop signs, outside-route, yield, deviation and blocking
candidate_rollout_requirements.official_efficiency_logic: carry the current route checkpoint accumulator into every candidate branch
candidate_rollout_requirements.official_smoothness_logic: carry segment boundary/history so a candidate is scored with the exact official 20-frame segmentation

explicit_conflicts: infraction compliance versus route completion in merge, overtake and detour
infraction compliance versus efficiency when larger safety margins require earlier braking
efficiency versus smoothness through acceleration and jerk
infraction compliance versus smoothness during necessary emergency braking
route completion versus smoothness because a stationary or blocked route can appear perfectly smooth

missingness_guards.efficiency: a route with no first checkpoint has no official Efficiency value but receives optimization value zero; always report efficiency route coverage
missingness_guards.smoothness: a route without a full official segment receives optimization value zero; always report smoothness route coverage
missingness_guards.reason: the official omission rules must not become a reward-hacking path

training_policy.imitation: retain the Stage2 reference through KL/BC; ADE is not a primary report-aligned objective
training_policy.ability_sampling: stratify or balance groups by the five official abilities and 44 scenario types

validation_gates: the route aggregator reproduces official DS, SR, Efficiency and Smoothness on saved official evaluation JSON/metric logs
the route aggregator reproduces all five official ability scores including Traffic-Signs special handling
candidate transitions preserve all route-state invariants
all four objectives show useful within-group variance on held-out training routes
injected collisions and traffic-rule violations never improve infraction compliance or B2D-RAS
efficiency and smoothness coverage are reported and cannot decrease silently
non-reactive candidate scores are correlated against reactive held-out CARLA rollouts before formal Stage3
reward configuration is frozen before the final complete 220-route evaluation
